messages:
Sam (eng): Heads-up — all-hands in 12m. Quick pre-check thread: AV, captions, and one tiny agenda swap (roadmap slide 4 -> slide 6).
Eli (infra): Obs recorder healthy, but saw a spike on the captions service earlier. Restarted the workers 10m ago. :crossed_fingers:
Marta (comms): Can we get the recording started asap so I can post to #recordings? Also need a clean speaker list for captions.
Jaya (prod): FYI leadership wants an extra 5m after Q&A for a short roadmap clarification. Can we shave 5m from the demo?
Ravi (design): Demo slides are 1–3; we can drop slide 2 animation to save time. @Jaya I’ll update the deck in 5.
Sam (eng): Great. @Ravi please upload to the shared drive and ping when done. Also, if captions glitch again, fallback plan is: record raw audio locally and attach with the video.
Marta (comms): Noted. Where should folks submit follow-up questions after the meeting? Do we keep the GDoc or use the thread?
Jaya (prod): Use the GDoc for structured Qs, but we’ll collect quick live ones in this thread. I'll triage.
allhands-bot: Recording will start in 3 minutes. Meeting link: https://zoom.company/all-hands — remember to mute on entry.
Eli (infra): Small ops note if OBS drops, run:
```
pkill obs || true
sleep 2
obs --startrecording --minimize-to-tray &
```
That should pick up the virtual cam again. Tested on staging.
Sam (eng): Thanks. Can someone watch captions at :30s into the talk — that’s where it usually stutters. @Eli?
Eli (infra): I’ll tail the captions logs. Command if needed: `tail -n 200 /var/log/captions/*.log | grep ERROR`
Ravi (design): Uploaded updated deck: drive.company/allhands/roadmap_v2.pptx — removed slide animation. :rocket:
Marta (comms): Got it. I’ll queue the recording post and set transcriptions to 48h retention.
Jaya (prod): Leadership ask: during the roadmap section please clarify timeline for Dedicated GA — 2 bullets only.
Sam (eng): Copy. Quick mic check for presenters — please mute when not speaking. Also reminder to keep to time.
Eli (infra): Caption worker showed a retry spike (500s) 6m ago but recovered. I’ll keep an eye and will flip to fallback caption host if it degrades.
Marta (comms): If captions do fail, note in the recording post and I'll attach the transcript from the local speaker notes.
Sam (eng): All set here. If OBS restarts, expect a 10–20s gap — we'll stitch in the editor.
Jaya (prod): Thanks team. See you in the room in 8. I’ll collect Qs and flag leadership ones. :white_check_mark:
Eli (infra): Monitoring live now.
Marta (comms): Posting the speaker list and slide links in 2.
Sam (eng): ok — thread closed unless something pops. Good luck! :thumbsup:
